notes: Stopped after four improvement cycles. Two cosmetic leftovers, both single pads, deferred.

defects.text: One elongated foliage pad still reaches above the oak_a crown (seen end-on it looks like a spike). Not from the dome fill or the sub-branch clusters, so the cap did not change it; likely a limb-end pad on the steepest limb.
defects.fix: Deferred: find the limb whose pad it is and tilt it down.

defects.text: One or two tip pads on oak_b still look detached from the limb network at close range.
defects.fix: Deferred: extend tip twigs to reach the pad bases.
